A standalone direct-multiplication verifier checked 126 complete finite configurations, including extension field order four, but finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Every prescribed root fiber and every kth-power image is a natural invariant of a finite group. This determines those invariants uniformly for all finite fields and multiquivers with square-zero radical, shows a sharp modular transition, and recovers complete element-order distributions. The graph partition makes the invariant structurally and computationally useful beyond isolated small examples.
